sources.quote: Correct, the audit qualifies the company. Part approvals stay as they are.

findings.why: The re-audit approves the company only. Part approvals are unchanged. No controlled record in the documents covers SUP-C for BR-225 at a receiving plant and customer. The documents do not give the customer of BR-225 either. Absence of a record is not proof of non-approval, so a person must confirm whether SUP-C is released for BR-225.

sources.quote: The 8D on the 6082 cracks is not closed yet, corrective action still being verified.
no new parts until 8D-25-031 is closed and re-audit passed

findings.why: The 8D on cracks in 6082 is still open at Meccanica Chisone. BR-225 is a milled aluminium bracket. The documents do not state its alloy, and the link between this 8D and 8D-25-031 is inferred from the superseded 2025 qualification record. Confirm that BR-225 is made from 6082. The new qualification (QS-C-2026) is based on the re-audit and does not say the 8D is closed.
